mapper.insert: INSERT INTO writing_library_prompts (topic_id, task_type, prompt_text, reference_answer, min_words, explanation, created_at) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{taskType}, #{promptText}, #{referenceAnswer}, #{minWords}, #{explanation}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic_id, task_type, prompt_text, reference_answer, min_words, explanation, created_at FROM writing_library_prompts WHERE id = #{promptId}
